Reimbursement claims, pending.

claims.txt holds one line per pending claim.
policy.txt defines the three bands claims are sorted into.
files.claims/policy.txt:
Reimbursement policy

Claims are banded by the amount claimed, in whole euros.
Band A: less than reimbursement.band_low.
Band B: from reimbursement.band_low up to, but not including, reimbursement.band_high.
Band C: reimbursement.band_high or more.
The two values are kept in the finance configuration.
